tint_modes.tinted_edge: mask = tex.a; final = mix(side_colour * side_tex(world v), top_colour * tex.rgb, mask) * tex_gain; rows 0-7 only
tint_modes.full: final = tex.rgb (vertex colour white; light and AO still apply)

verdant_meadow.why: Home biome: brighter, fresher yellow-green so it feels sunny and inviting; warmer dirt.

whispering_forest.why: Darker and a bit bluer than the meadow so the border between them is clear; old one was too dark.

emerald_jungle.why: Pushed toward emerald (blue-green, very saturated) so it is not just 'another forest'.

frostpine_taiga.why: Cool teal-green: reads 'cold' next to the warm forest. Gravel shores instead of sand.

murk_swamp.why: Olive and low saturation: the only 'dirty' green. Mud texture carries the wet look.

sandy_beach.why: Almost unchanged; a touch less yellow so it differs from desert orange.

sunscorch_desert.why: More orange than the beach; deeper red-orange mesas so cliffs stand out against the sand.

snowy_tundra.why: Snow stays near white but cool; darker frozen dirt so snow caps read as a bright lip.

stonecrown_mountains.why: Sage alpine grass (lighter, greyer); warm grey rock so cliffs are not cold blue-grey.

crystal_glade.why: A bit more saturated violet/blue so the magic biome pops; it is the rare 'wow' place.

deep_ocean.why: Kept; seen through water. Small lift so the sea floor is not black on the web renderer.

the_deeps.why: Slightly lighter, purple-tinted grey: without ambient occlusion (web) the old cave rock was nearly black.
